Log maven-20261120-204031.log:6454 shows 1/1 pass.

findings.description: Detail assertion checks only prefix and one message; it does not cover multiple violations being sorted and joined by '; '. Acceptable for the brief's single criterion.
findings.suggestion: Optional: add a second parameter to assert the sorted '; ' join.
